components:combobox-field.title: Combobox Field
components:combobox-field.description: The searchable single-select field for long option lists, with shared Field anatomy, form submission, keyboard navigation, filtering, empty and invalid states, and anchored paper-menu motion.

components:search-field.title: Search Input
components:search-field.description: Accessible search input with optional visible label and description, form-friendly name and required props, shortcut hint, clear action, sm/md/lg sizing, and bindable value.

components:command-palette.title: Command Palette
components:command-palette.description: Keyboard-accessible command palette with search, grouped results, empty state, shortcut trigger, and keyboard navigation.

components:carousel-nav.title: Carousel Navigation
components:carousel-nav.description: Accessible previous, next, position, and direct-slide controls for any caller-composed carousel, with bindable position and a composable completion action.

components:select-menu.title: Select Menu
components:select-menu.description: Generic select menu with an explicit flat or grouped option source, optional visible label, inline or stacked trigger value, descriptions, preview adornments, bindable open state, and trigger/list motion.

components:select-field.title: Select Field
components:select-field.description: Plain labeled select field with optional description, simple options, bindable value and open state, and form-friendly name, required, disabled, and autocomplete props.

components:dropdown-menu.title: Dropdown Menu
components:dropdown-menu.description: Button-triggered dropdown menu with option descriptions, shortcut badges, disabled rows, and danger-toned actions.

components:tooltip.title: Tooltip
components:tooltip.description: Accessible hover and focus tooltip with caller-owned label text, optional shortcut hint, bindable open state, and semantic side and alignment options.

components:input-field.title: Input Field
components:input-field.description: Generic labeled text input field with generated or caller-supplied IDs, optional description, validation message, bindable value, text-like input types, and form-friendly required, disabled, and readonly states.

components:email-capture-form.title: Email Capture Form
components:email-capture-form.description: Small email capture form with an accessible label, optional description or consent text, bindable value, and explicit submit button label.

components:color-field.title: Color Field
components:color-field.description: Labeled color picker field with bindable value, optional description and validation message, disabled and required states, and focus styling.

components:textarea-field.title: Textarea Field
components:textarea-field.description: Generic labeled textarea field with optional description, validation message, bindable value, rows, resize behavior, and form-friendly required, disabled, and readonly states.

components:range-field.title: Range Field
components:range-field.description: The canonical labeled slider field with one paper-styled track and thumb, bindable value, output, limits, validation, and disabled state.

components:segmented-control.title: Segmented Control
components:segmented-control.description: One canonical segmented control with bindable value, typed options, disabled items, and shared focus and motion styling.

components:category-filter.title: Category Filter
components:category-filter.description: Reusable category tablist with horizontal, vertical, or responsive orientation, disabled categories, bindable active value, and focus/motion styling.

components:checkbox-field.title: Checkbox Field
components:checkbox-field.description: Labeled checkbox field with stable control IDs, optional description, invalid message, indeterminate state, and checked/focus treatment.

components:switch-field.title: Switch Field
components:switch-field.description: Labeled switch field with stable control IDs, optional description and validation message, bindable checked state, and tokenized toggle motion for binary settings.

components:option-selector.title: Option Selector
components:option-selector.description: Radio-style option selector with bindable value, labels, disabled options, callbacks, and focus/motion styling.

components:radio-group-field.title: Radio Group Field
components:radio-group-field.description: Generic labeled radio group field with option descriptions, disabled options, bindable value, vertical or responsive grid layout, and tokenized selected/focus states.

components:quantity-stepper.title: Quantity Stepper
components:quantity-stepper.description: Bounded quantity stepper with accessible labels, disabled min/max states, stable numeric output, and value-change callbacks.

components:pin-pad.title: PIN Pad
components:pin-pad.description: Accessible numeric PIN entry with token-sized keypad controls, masked progress, bounded length, deletion, and completion callbacks.

components:pattern-input.title: Pattern Input
components:pattern-input.description: Accessible three-by-three pattern input with direct dot selection, connected path feedback, a bindable value, and one canonical clear action.

components:verification-code-field.title: Verification Code Field
components:verification-code-field.description: A single opinionated one-time-code field with bindable value, accessible labeling, fixed token sizing, and completion feedback.
